description: Human camouflage score ratings of 44 independently optimized 1000-iteration local v1-best moths. Original records, no exclusions.
earlier_export: gitai_human_ratings_compact_2026-10-14(1).json (25 bark records, all contained in later export)
background_snapshot_note: All 3 background IDs and image_data_url values in new export match the four backgrounds in the previous 962-rating archive; snapshots are referenced rather than duplicated.
selection_bias_note: Selected from 1081 attempts maximizing local v1; not a representative random specimen sample. High-score machine conditioning and fixed evaluation positions limit generality. Do not relabel as 100-point numeric machine score.
scoring_definition: The human category completed ('完成域') means the known moth position is almost impossible to distinguish, including boundary and pattern. No background-independent numeric cutoff assumed.
